parole.significato: hail (balls of ice falling as precipitation)
parole.testo: Probably from a Pre-Roman Celtic root caria martia ("stones of March"), analogically to calabruix (“hail”). If so, comparable to modern Welsh cerrig Mawrth (“stones of March”).
